title: Evidence-Driven Fleet Risk Management Platform
metaTitle: Evidence-Driven Fleet Risk Management Platform | FleetGoo
metaDesc: All-in-one fleet platform integrating AI video safety evidence, managed services, and closed-loop risk control — built for insurers, TSPs, OEMs, and enterprise fleets.

blocks.title: Evidence-Driven Fleet Risk Management
blocks.subtitle: Turn every trip into verifiable safety intelligence. AI-powered video capture, tamper-proof evidence chains, and closed-loop risk control — built for fleets, insurers, and the technology partners who connect them.

items.title: Video Safety Evidence
items.desc: Every incident captured in HD, timestamped, and stored in a tamper-proof evidence chain. AI-triggered recording ensures you never miss the critical moment — and the evidence always holds up when it matters most.

items.title: Managed Safety Service
items.desc: Don't just deploy technology — deploy a safety operation. Our 24/7 monitoring team watches your fleet around the clock, triages alerts, and delivers actionable safety reports so your team can focus on running the business.

items.title: Risk Control Closed-Loop
items.desc: Detect → Alert → Coach → Measure → Improve. We close the loop between risk detection and behavioral change, turning raw driving data into measurable safety outcomes.

items.title: Cloud Command Center
items.desc: A centralized cloud hub to monitor fleet status in real time, replay route history, and manage driver and vehicle profiles — accessible from any browser, anywhere.

items.title: Mobile Fleet Apps
items.desc: Native iOS and Android apps with role-based experiences for managers and drivers — task dispatch, real-time notifications, and on-the-go fleet management.

items.title: Video Telematics Engine
items.desc: A unified video + GPS + AI engine. HD road and in-cabin footage, AI-triggered recording, and high-precision positioning — one deployment, multi-dimensional data capture.

items.title: Open API & Integrations
items.desc: RESTful API + Webhooks to seamlessly connect fleet data with your existing ERP, CRM, or business systems — let data flow freely across your organization.

items.title: Advanced Analytics
items.desc: Transform raw fleet data into actionable insights — predictive maintenance alerts, fuel consumption analysis, and driver behavior scoring to drive every operational decision.

items.title: Enterprise-Grade Security
items.desc: AES-256 encryption, SSO support, and granular role-based access control (RBAC) — meeting the compliance and audit requirements enterprises demand.

items.title: Operations Dashboard
items.desc: Three-pillar reporting across operations, safety, and compliance — safety scores, risk trends, and device uptime at a glance, giving management a complete view of fleet health.

items.title: Fleet Risk Assessment
items.desc: A fleet-wide risk quantification system — overall risk ratings, driver risk behavior profiling, and per-100km risk analysis. Define safety levels with data, and make management decisions with confidence.

items.title: Real-Time Vehicle Intelligence
items.desc: Live telemetry for every vehicle — position, speed, status, mileage, and driving time — presented on an interactive map where anomalies are instantly visible.

items.title: Live Video Surveillance
items.desc: Stream live HD footage from any vehicle's road-facing and in-cabin cameras at any time. Multi-channel simultaneous viewing, instant snapshot, and two-way intercom put you in the driver's seat.

items.title: Active Safety Alerts
items.desc: ADAS and DMS monitor driving risk in real time — forward collision warnings, lane departure, driver fatigue, and distraction events trigger instant alerts. Every triggered event is automatically recorded with video evidence for full traceability and review.

items.title: Driver Identity Verification
items.desc: Pre-register driver profiles and photos on the platform. When a vehicle starts, the system automatically verifies the current driver's identity — ensuring only authorized personnel operate your fleet, controlling human risk at the source.

items.title: Remote Vehicle Control
items.desc: Remote snapshot, two-way intercom, PTZ control, and over-the-air parameter configuration — every command delivered and executed instantly, with no distance limitations.

items.title: Video & Track Playback
items.desc: Replay any trip in full context — route trajectory, stop points, alarm events, and speed curves synchronized with multi-channel video. Downloadable for offline review or evidence archiving.

items.title: Geofence Management
items.desc: Define virtual boundary zones and receive instant alerts when vehicles enter or exit — ideal for route compliance enforcement and depot security monitoring.

items.title: AI Assistant
items.desc: A built-in AI assistant powered by large language models. Ask questions in natural language — query data, spot trends, find anomalies — and get precise answers instantly. Complex fleet analytics, simplified to a conversation.

items.title: Multi-Platform Access
items.desc: Web portal, desktop client, mobile app, and mini-program — one platform, every screen, real-time sync. Your fleet operations stay connected without interruption.

items.title: For Insurers & Underwriters
items.desc: Equip your insured fleets with evidence-grade video safety. Accelerate claims resolution with tamper-proof incident replay, reduce fraud exposure, and design usage-based premium incentives backed by real driving behavior data.

items.title: For Telematics Service Providers
items.desc: Embed proven video safety into your existing telematics stack. White-label deployment, open API integration, and a fully managed backend — you own the customer relationship while we power the platform.

items.title: For OEMs & Enterprise Fleets
items.desc: Factory-fit or retrofit, our platform adapts to your vehicle architecture and operational scale. From single-fleet deployment to multi-region managed safety programs with 24/7 monitoring support.
